first_cell.representation_for_substantive_calibrati: original frozen CPU FP32 E5; complete cache qualification still required

later_cells: News/E5 next after separate eligibility and review; do not create additional MPNet arms.
recommendation: Local cross-family model panel plus one-author blinded probability audit, with original-label utility and exact repair as principal empirical anchors.

technical_pilot.frame: real calibration pairs in separately labelled existing engineering pack

models.role: cached pilot candidate and proposed first panel member
resource-feasible cross-family candidate; not validated for this annotation task

judge_runtime.canonical_orientation: stable hash of plan digest and unordered pair identity
judge_runtime.overlap_replay_rule: fresh isolated canonical calls; any category change makes model validation unavailable, no retries for agreement
judge_runtime.swapped_calls: 10% SRS diagnostics only, not additional votes

model_labels.primary_positive_rule: both distinct-family judge outputs valid and positive
model_labels.uncertain_disagreement_unavailable_rule: binary positive/nonpositive disagreement, uncertainty, or unavailable: zero positive numerator; retain full denominator weight and distinct status. Different positive categories remain panel-positive and are logged as six-way disagreement.

calibration.validation_frame: ALL score>locked_tau calibration pairs; not only model positives
calibration.bound_target: fixed/potential model-panel label function under stated sampling design

human_audit.probability_frame: ALL score>locked_tau calibration pairs from the complete frozen source-disjoint frame; no model-positive, availability, length or convenient-pack filter.
human_audit.small_frame_policy: census with actual count and disclosed shortfall; no convenient replacement
human_audit.missing_uncertain_skipped_rule: nonpositive in conservative bound; preserve all planned sampled units
human_audit.inference_scope: single author fixed/potential outcomes under the stated rubric and sampling design; not human consensus or reliability
human_audit.no_threshold_pass_policy: no above-threshold support claim; any diagnostic audit is labelled separately before collection
human_audit.overlap_policy: Pilot/selection overlap is allowed under independent SRS; record overlap and prior model exposure, obtain the author first blinded response without showing prior model judgments.
